newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends up as cash market begins to firm.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends up as cash market begins to firm.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher on signs the domestic and Asian cash markets were beginning to firm, traders said.
"The domestic cash market has firmed in the past 24 hours," a trader said.
Traders said slow farmer selling also contributed to the gains.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 450 contracts, up from 366 Wednesday.
Rice futures closed four to five cents per cwt higher, with November up five at $9.88 per cwt.
